title: Spawner Skills
summary: A large collection of YAML-defined "skills" that give Claude structured domain knowledge and code templates, including a synthetic-data skill for AI agents to generate and evaluate tabular synthetic data. That skill embeds Python scripts invoking SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and evaluate_quality functions, packaging the SDV single-table API as an on-demand capability the agent executes.
evidence: ai/synthetic-data/skill.yaml:169-228 embeds Python using sdv.single_table synthesizers, sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata, and sdv.evaluation.single_table.evaluate_quality
needs: Cannot confirm the generated Python script is actually executed vs. only templated text within the skill definition.
